points.name: health.oxygen.low_chart.info_register
points.interpretation: Two chart-building branches register the explanation callback with filter 7 and user data 5.

evidence: The oxygen application registers both descriptors. The measurement create allocates state and its destroy stops relevant measurement resources and frees it. The preparation builder sets a wear image and text; the status handler selects one of four localized messages. The low chart stores its root and clears it on destroy; for one or two records the chart builder registers the same explanation callback and icon in two distinct layout paths.
scope: Only recorded UI and event-data calls. Sensor acquisition, measurement results, data storage and other explanation paths are not intercepted.
limitations: Changing status text can misrepresent measurement state. Modifying event data may change navigation arguments. Image resources must remain valid while used. Root slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
